name: Paseo
description: Make the first assignment to a Paseo executor. Paseo owns execution and task state.

methods.whenToUse: Make the initial assignment to an allowed Paseo project.
methods.guidanceMd: Enter your Paseo assignment endpoint ending in /mcp/handoff and its restricted assignment key. Assign work with paseo_assign. Reuse the same task_ref and brief when a reply is lost. The acceptance receipt ends Paperclip's role; execution, goals, task state and review remain in Paseo.
